pages.text: Ema allows you to bind data to your Touken Danshi and summon them to your side at any time. $(#ff0000)$(bold)Note: In the current version, there is no way to summon a Touken Danshi back from an unloaded chunk!$()

pages.title: Ema
pages.text: The data of Ema is updated in real time, and it can be crafted.
